    About the studio

    Kiln & Clover started in a converted dairy in 2019 with one wheel, a second-hand kiln and a lot of enthusiasm. Today there are six wheels, two kilns and a long table for hand building by the window.

    We teach the way we would want to be taught: slowly, kindly and with plenty of mud. Nobody is expected to be good at it on day one.

    Meet your teacher

    Hannah trained as a production potter before opening the studio. She still makes the tableware sold in the village shop, and she will happily show you how.
